title: Visit the Atrium | Pricing Sheet and Tours | Vertical Life
description: Plan a visit to the Atrium in Carmel. Fill out one short form and we'll send the pricing sheet, text you within 2 hours and share a link to book your tour.

blocks.headline: Come and see
blocks.body: Membership starts with a conversation, not a contract. Fill out the form and we'll send the pricing sheet, then a link to book your tour.

blocks.heading: Plan your visit
blocks.body: Tell us a little about you and your team. Someone from the Atrium will follow up personally.

blocks.heading: What happens next
items: Fill out the form on this page
Get the pricing sheet by email, plus a text from us within 2 hours
Pick a tour time from the link we send
Walk the space, meet a few people and decide

items.question: Where is the Atrium?
items.answer: 10330 N Meridian St, Suite 300, Indianapolis, IN 46290, on N Meridian near Carmel.

items.question: Can I see prices first?
items.answer: Yes. Every package and room rate is on the [Atrium page](/the-atrium#packages).
